logger.doc:name: Supplier Submission Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Submitting supplier order for SKU: ' ++ (vars.queuePayload.sku default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' with Correlation ID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default 'NONE')]

when.expression: #[isEmpty(payload.supplierCode default '') or isEmpty(payload.deliverToWarehouse default '') or isEmpty(payload.lines default []) or (payload.lines[0].quantity default 0) <= 0]

raise-error.description: Supplier order validation failed: missing mandatory fields or non-positive quantity.

logger.doc:name: Log Supplier Conflict
logger.message: #['Supplier API returned HTTP 409 Conflict. Reconciling order via idempotency key: ' ++ vars.supplierIdempotencyKey]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', statusCode: (vars.supplierAttributes.statusCode default 0), idempotencyKey: vars.supplierIdempotencyKey, responseBody: payload }]

logger.doc:name: Log MOQ Rejection
logger.message: #['Supplier API returned HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity (MOQ violation).']

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'MOQ_REJECTED', statusCode: (vars.supplierAttributes.statusCode default 0), responseBody: payload }]

logger.doc:name: Log Service Unavailable
logger.message: Supplier service returned HTTP 503 Unavailable. Triggering retry/backoff flow.

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'TRANSIENT_ERROR', statusCode: (vars.supplierAttributes.statusCode default 0), responseBody: payload }]

logger.doc:name: Log Successful Submission
logger.message: Supplier API successfully accepted purchase order.

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { outcome: 'SUBMITTED', statusCode: (vars.supplierAttributes.statusCode default 0), idempotencyKey: vars.supplierIdempotencyKey, responseBody: payload }]
